market.what: Cooling-tower water treatment (scale, corrosion, biocide) at data centers, world
market.method: est. US DC water ~25 bn gal/yr 2025 (17 in 2023, 38-73 in 2028) x COC 5 makeup ~31 bn gal x $3/kgal treatment = ~$95M; US ~40% of world -> ~$230M; all-industry reports $12.6-29.5B

value.logic: P-free inhibitor that holds scale at COC 8 vs 4: world DC evaporation ~60 bn gal (est.) -> makeup 80 to 69, blowdown 20 to 9 bn gal; 11 bn gal x ($5 water + $10 sewer)/kgal = ~$170M; plus no P-removal at outfall
value.revenue_logic: 2032 DC tower treatment ~$600M x ~30% actives value x ~50% P-free x ~12% share = ~$11M, sold to service cos
value.margin_logic: specialty polymer/small-molecule active sold to formulators; service cos keep the markup

trend.drivers: US DC water 17 bn gal (2023) to 38-73 bn gal (2028); P-impaired rivers get ~1 ppm P outfall limits; water scrutiny on AI sites
trend.deadline: EU Urban Wastewater Directive recast 2024/3019 (tighter P removal, phased to 2039); local P permit limits now

competition.notes: Ecolab serves >1,000 data centers and is adding CoolIT ($4.75B, 2026); non-P polymer programs already sold by majors, so we must beat them at high COC. Gradiant raised $225M (2023).

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom (carboxylate/sulfonate small molecule or short oligomer), 3 variants
lab.test: AMPP/NACE TM0374 CaCO3 jar test + dynamic tube-blocking + ASTM D2688 coupons / LPR corrosion; then pilot cooling-tower rig; univ. or water-treatment lab
lab.logic: 5-6 wk CRO synth + 6 wk tests; 3 x ~$6k synth + ~$10k scale/corrosion tests + ~$7k pilot rig

sale.gates: field trial on one DC tower 3-6 mo; service co (Ecolab/ChemTreat) or operator approval; discharge permit check; no EPA registration (non-biocide)
